subject: Novalabs renewal — stage gate, perf recap & capacity uplift options
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@novalabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novalabs renewal — stage gate, perf recap & capacity uplift options

Hi Elena —

Quick summary ahead of the week: we pulled the May usage and perf numbers and there are three items we think are important for the renewal conversation next month:

1) Token spend trend — up 42% MoM in May, driven by increased bot traffic and a new classification workflow you rolled out.
2) Latency profile — 95th percentile for single-request generation is 220ms in us-west (attached latency_benchmarks_may.csv).
3) ROI signal — conversions attributed to the LLM feature rose ~11% in the segment you care about; that maps to a clear revenue uplift in Q2.

Options we recommend for term/commit:
- Short path (recommended): 12-month renewal, base commit + 30% headroom (staged: +10% at T+0, +20% at T+90) to avoid throttling during peak ramp.
- Conservative: 6-month renewal with a burst credit pool and a monitored auto-scale policy.
- Aggressive: 24-month with larger discount but commit targets and a quarterly usage review.

I've attached the May usage report and a draft mutual action plan with proposed milestones. Ben — can you confirm the price ladder if they go 12 vs 24 months? Grace — want to align CS runbook and onboarding steps for the extra throughput.

Can we do a 30-minute sync Mon or Tue next week to walk through the numbers with Samir and finance?

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: usage_report_May2028.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: latency_benchmarks_may.csv (CSV, 45KB)]

Thanks Jasmine — helpful overview. A couple quick points from our side:

- The 42% increase in tokens is real; we saw it the week the classification workflow rolled out. Good to see the conversion lift.
- Finance is concerned about higher committed spend without guaranteed ROI — they asked whether we can structure a performance-adjusted rebate or a staged SLA credit if latency or availability dips.

Samir (cc) is handling procurement. Samir — if we pursue the 12-month base + headroom plan, we need a simple mechanism to adjust the commitment at Q2 review and a clear runbook for credits if critical SLOs break.

I'm available Tue 10–11 PT for a call.

Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Product, Novalabs
elena@novalabs.com

Elena — quick pricing note from my side. High-level ladder if Novalabs chooses the 12-month path vs 24-month:

- 12-month (recommended): base price as-is, 12% discount on incremental headroom usage above commit; option to convert headroom to committed units at the next quarterly review.
- 24-month: 18% discount on incremental headroom and an annual true-up.

For a performance-adjusted rebate: we can offer credits tied to availability (monthly SLA) and an extra credit bucket if p95 latency crosses 350ms for two consecutive weeks. We prefer credits over dollar refunds to keep the relationship operational.

I'll prepare a redline friendly clause and share a short spreadsheet mapping token tiers to $/1M tokens — that should help finance model it.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: pricing_ladder_Q2_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 65KB)]

Subject: Novalabs PO and procurement constraints

Thanks team. Procurement notes from my side:

- We need net-30 payment terms but can accept a slightly longer payment schedule for the initial ramp if there is mutual comfort around the staged commit.
- For the 12-month option we prefer the ability to downscope headroom at the Q2 review (not automatically increase). Can you add a clause for a one-time downward adjustment to headroom with 30 days' notice and a proportional refund to the headroom prepayment?

I can sign the PO once the mutual action plan has the following: milestone dates, acceptance criteria, and the SLA credit table. Can you route a DocuSign link for the pilot addendum and the PO?

Samir Patel
